purpose: Fair same-parameter cross-check on a normally-covering tier23 sample (SRR1460477, 67-71% mapping class): full pipeline SRA-to-quant.sf through the public CLI with the mainline's exact salmon parameters (--seqBias --gcBias included after the first pass revealed the parameter gap), then transcript-level comparison against the mainline's stored quant.sf. Result: NumReads identical (relative difference 0) and TPM Pearson r = 1.000000 - the SDK reproduces the reference pipeline bit-for-bit when parameters match.

methodology.disclosure: wall times are HDD-throughput-bound on this host (benchmark I/O volume is a 500 GB 7200rpm HDD); timings characterize the deployment, not an engine speedup claim
